title: RecipientPickerField: no picker mode for the `field` sharing recipient — an admin has to type the field name into the degraded text input
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#15072

Filed by the `os-dev` seat implementing objectstack#15072 (session `session_01XpTx2tbq3pZRYAdoGt6E6Y`, branch `claude/issue-15072-field-sharing-recipient`) as an out-of-scope finding; nothing in this card is fixed by that PR, and this card is not addressed there.

## What

`packages/fields/src/widgets/RecipientPickerField.tsx` maps `recipient_type` to a target object (`TYPE_TO_OBJECT`: `user` / `team` / `business_unit` / `unit_and_subordinates` / `position`) and, per its own header, "Unknown types degrade to a plain text input so nothing breaks."

`sys_sharing_rule.recipient_type` gains a sixth value, `field`, with objectstack#15072 (the executor half of the maintainer ruling on objectstack#14103): the recipient is the user or users named by a **user-typed field of the shared object**, so `recipient_id` stores a **field name** (`assignees`, `owner_manager`), not a record id. For that kind the picker has no mapping and falls through to the text input — functional, but the admin must know and type the machine name of the column by hand, with no list of the object's user-typed fields to choose from and no validation that the name exists.

## Suggested shape

When `dependentValues.recipient_type === 'field'`, offer the shared object's fields (read from `dependentValues.object_name`, the same dependency `object_name` → `filter-condition` already uses) restricted to user-valued ones — `type: 'user'`, or a `lookup` / `master_detail` whose `reference` is `sys_user` — and store the field **name**. The executor reads exactly that value and treats a column that is not user-typed as "grants nobody" (with a logged warning), so the picker's filter and the runtime's judgement should agree.

## Where measured

- objectui `packages/fields/src/widgets/RecipientPickerField.tsx` (`TYPE_TO_OBJECT`, the header's "Unknown types degrade to a plain text input" sentence) — no `field` entry.
- objectstack `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/objects/sys-sharing-rule.object.ts` — the `recipient_type` select gains `field`; the `recipient_id` help text now says the value is the name of the record field for that type.

Not a defect in what ships today (the degraded input stores the right value); an authoring-experience gap that opens the day the select carries the new value.
